projects.title: The Day Beneath Silence
projects.description: Some invent, some merely pass through, some exhaust themselves in vain to find the portal; some suddenly awaken to the world's true meaning. At times life tastes bland, and we yearn for some distant shore.

projects.title: OASIS
projects.description:
”The city seems to leave no space unclaimed. Between concrete, light, and ceaseless movement, the body can only carve out a small space in which to breathe.“

about *OASIS*

Oasis is a one-look fashion project exploring the relationship between clothing, architecture and personal space.

Inspired by the centrifugal structures of Italian architect Aldo Loris Rossi, the garment expands outward from the body through exaggerated shoulders, rounded sleeves and a distorted silhouette. Rather than following the body’s natural proportions, it constructs a temporary space around the wearer.

The contrast between black and white draws from Jesse Draxler’s monochromatic collage practice, translating visual fragmentation into contrasting panels, displaced proportions and interrupted lines. References to 2000s sportswear and contemporary street styling bring these architectural and graphic elements back into a wearable context.

Developed after the garment was completed, the title *Oasis* describes the space created between the body and its surroundings: a portable zone of protection within the density of the city.
